Declared HS 690721 is confirmed by the 2025-12-04 and 2025-11-26 records; the company also ships 690722/690723 variants, so the code is correct but not exclusive. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: the web_search tool returned connection errors on all attempts and registry/aggregator pages (thecompanycheck, volza) returned HTTP 403. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null (ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values). Note: a separate entity "CEROTO INTERNATIONAL LLP" exists on ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ceroto-international-llp) with no shipment rows displayed; it is not the same record and was not used as evidence.
